scope: Twelve original studies: one primary system, three additional organic-electroreduction comparators, four mechanism/method neighbors, and four mandatory conceptual anchors. Categories are not interchangeable.
evidence_boundary: LITERATURE FACT denotes what the original publication reports, not independent confirmation. Missing source details remain unavailable.

counting_boundary.note: The contract requests directly relevant original studies, not eight studies on an identical reaction. Eight relevant studies are present only under an explicit mechanism/method-inclusive definition. Same-system count is one; four thermal/anodic conceptual anchors are not used to fill this count.
